shayari:
Tujhse hi subah, tujhse hi shaam hai,
Tu hi meri dhadkan, tu hi mera naam hai.
Jab bhi socha tujhe, dil ne kaha —
Tu mere life ka sabse khoobsurat anjaam hai.

Raat ke taaron mein teri baat hoti hai,
Dil ke darr mein teri yaad hoti hai.
Kya bataun kaise rehta hoon main tere bin —
Har saans mein sirf teri mulaqat hoti hai.

Tu woh khwaab hai jo aankhen khuli rehti hain,
Tu woh raaz hai jo dil mein zindagi rehti hain.
Log poochte hain mujhse kya hai tujhe —
Main kehta hoon woh jo tere bina adhoori rehti hain.

Teri aankhon mein ek duniya basi hai meri,
Teri muskaan mein hai zindagi khushi teri.
Tu na ho to lagta hai sab kuch adhoora hai —
Mera sapna, meri dua, meri manzil — sab tu hi teri.
